vacancies.title: Payload Engineer
vacancies.location: Noordwijk, Netherlands (Space Business Park / ESTEC area)
vacancies.assessment: Strong MSc mechanical-engineering fit and direct Noordwijk ESTEC-area exposure. ICE Cubes ISS payload engineering combines CAD, mechanical/electrical interface control, requirements, hardware integration, testing, qualification and customer/supplier coordination. Direct human-spaceflight work is attractive; avionics/fluidic-system design and ISS-specific PA/safety experience are the main gaps. Permanent full-time contract advertised.

vacancies.title: PA and Safety Support Engineer (IRIS²)
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC IRIS2 PA&S, spacecraft MAIT and test review role; strong ESA exposure and PA interest. However requires ten years in the space sector including five years Product/Quality Assurance, a substantial specialist experience gap. Permanent position.

vacancies.title: RF & Microwave Lab Manager
vacancies.assessment: Direct onsite ESTEC RF/microwave laboratory management and hardware qualification/testing exposure. Technical lab leadership and automation fit partially, but specialised RF payload and microwave test expertise, NEN3140 and laboratory management make this a substantial stretch.

vacancies.title: Configuration, Data & Documentation Management Engineer
vacancies.location: ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands or ECSAT, Harwell, UK
vacancies.assessment: ESTEC-facing ESA configuration, documentation and review-data control; three years dedicated configuration-management experience required. January 2027 start, placement may be Harwell.

vacancies.title: Schedule & Risk Management Engineer
vacancies.location: ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands or ECSAT, Harwell, UK
vacancies.assessment: ESA project planning, schedule control and risk analysis at ESTEC or Harwell. Requires advanced Primavera and schedule-risk skills. Expected January 2027 start.
